title: 第7章 法诀

第7章 法诀
夺目的晨曦从大黎山跃出，抚过金灿灿的望月湖，风扫过层层叠叠，一望无迹的芦苇荡，带来眉尺河上孩子们嬉笑打闹声。
陈二牛坐在田埂上，忧虑重重地望着田里的作物，心里想着卧病在床的妇人。
陈二牛出生在大黎山东边的梨川口，十年前梨川口无缘无故平地大旱。不但滴水不降，地里还吭哧吭哧地冒白烟，吓得村里人四散而逃。
他当时还是个半大孩子，迷迷糊糊就逃到了黎泾村，在他苦苦哀求之下农户李根水收留了他，次年更是租了一亩地给他活命。
待到他年长时，他又多租了一亩水田，建了土房，娶了李根水的女儿，风风光光地在村子里扎下了根。
可妻子突然病了，好在他这些年还算有些积蓄，抬到村口让韩先生一看——小病而已吃几副药即可。他把妻子安置在先生处，提的心却迟迟放不下来，一病穷三代啊！
“姑父！”陈二牛出着神呢，一道爽朗的声音惊醒了他。
却见院口走了一个俊朗的年青人，脸上带着热切的笑意，正朝着他打招呼。
“诶，长湖啊，担不得，担不得！”
陈二牛连连弯腰，他不过娶了李家的一个庶出女，又是人家的租户，当真是当不起长子这么一声称。
李根水精明能干，偏偏花心得很，娶了妻子不够，还去道上收留了两个女人做妾。他的妻子给他生了两个男丁，小妾却生了三儿四女。
当年李根水老得快死了，唯一陪在身边嫡亲小儿子却就这样暴毙，几个庶子年轻力壮，对着家里的十几亩地虎视眈眈。
这时离家出走的李木田提着刀带着人回来了，这个凶残的老兵一刀就砍死了吃里扒外的管家，毒死他弟弟准备行兼并之举的那家大户满门被杀了个干干净净，连条狗都没有放过。
李木田和他那两位弟兄提着滴着血的刀，用推车拖着尸体，血淋淋的痕迹从村尾拖到村头，村子里家家闭户，人人自危。李木田的几个弟弟吓得惊慌失措，本以为正主来了，这田地准是没份了。
谁知李木田将几个兄弟唤来，说什么是嫡庶之间本是同气连枝，将大户的土地一人两亩分了，又给自己带回来的弟兄一人四亩地，感激得几个弟弟连连称主家大哥，就这样定下了名分。
看着李长湖温和的笑容，不知怎么的和李木田淡漠的溅着血的脸庞重合在一起，陈二牛顶着大太阳打了个寒战，恭恭敬敬地问道：
“长湖这是来？”
“诶，姑夫太客气了。”李长湖笑了笑，轻声说：
“听说姑妈病了，家父寻思着姑夫腾不出手来做饭，特地叫我来请您与小泽来家里尝尝我母亲的手艺。”

“这…太不好意思了。”陈二牛勉强一笑，进退两难。
“就这么定了！母亲已经备好饭菜。”李长湖拍了拍陈二牛的肩膀，告辞离去。
“好嘞。”陈二牛笑着摇了摇头，往屋内喊着：
“小泽，收拾一下，晚上去你舅舅家吃饭。”
李家前年修好了宅子，占地扩大了好几倍，整个宅院坐北朝南，呈长方形，前院砌了石砖，摆了石锁，看着像练武的地儿，陈二牛看着这石锁份量不小，不禁啧啧称赞：
“李家莫不是还有练武的法门，好一个石锁。”
踩着石砖进了正院，中心砌了一座塘，放了几只青鱼在里头，青石围成的大堂左右是李长湖与李通崖的配房，房屋、游廊、大门和二门底部铺有条石或石阶，看上去气派极了。
李通崖招呼着也进了正院，如今他已经十八岁了，却还未娶妻。李长湖倒是娶了任家的次女，前些时候已经风风光光地娶进门了。
陈二牛与李家众人吃了晚饭，坐在院中有一搭没一搭地聊天，却见李尺泾匆匆忙忙地走进前院，伏在李木田耳边轻轻说了几句。
李尺泾方才九岁，却长得俊美，一副聪慧机灵的模样，惹得叔侄兄弟们尤为喜欢。
李木田正悠闲地看着儿辈聊天，却听李尺泾附在耳边轻声说：
“父亲，那…鉴子亮了！”
他不动声色，拍了拍双腿，朝着众人开口道：
“人老了，却是坐不住了，我且去歇息，你们聊罢。”说着转身去了后院，众人连忙应是，陈二牛躬身便欲告辞了。
后堂立了几厢房，李木田进了坐落在最中央也是最宽大的祠堂，进了祠堂，前边立着牌位，放着瓜果，祭祀翻遍村志找出来的六代祖宗。
李木田在墙面上一推，现出后边的隔间来。
隔间开着天窗，月光洒落在内里一座青石砌成的石台上。
石台上边放着一面青灰色的铜镜，果然正明晃晃地放着如水般的白光。
“三年了……泾儿，去把你哥哥们都叫来。”
李木田望着青灰铜镜，皱着眉头道。

“是。”李尺泾用力点头，出门去找哥哥们了。
————
陆江仙醒来时，脑海中沉甸甸地塞满了信息，他缓了一柱香的时间，开始静心读取玉石上的信息。
《太阴吐纳养轮经》！
这道法决主要讲授如何通过人体的“窍”来操控天地灵气，勾动太阴月华，最后修成胎息六轮，便可以借助这六轮延寿养性，施展种种法术。六轮养到如同满月后便可进入练气期。
其后还附了几门小术，如金光术、净衣术、避水法、驱邪术、心络术等等，只要修出六轮，按照法决催动灵气即可。
同时，法决谈到修仙六境分为胎息，练气，筑基，紫府，金丹，元婴。而这玉石记载的正是越国仙府月华元府的胎息养轮法，发放给月华仙府胎息弟子学习修炼。
陆江仙在吞噬玉石后只觉得无形之中明悟了许多东西，不但神识范围扩大到了二十丈，而且月华之力上限也翻了好几十翻，只要月华之力足够，《太阴吐纳养轮经》中记载的几门小术也可以在镜身一丈内施展出来。
最重要的是，镜子本身记忆中浮现出了一道法术，唤作：
《玄珠祀灵术》！
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 7 Secrets
The dazzling morning light leaps out from Dali Mountain and caresses over the golden Wangyue Lake. The wind sweeps through the endless layers of reeds, bringing with it the sound of children laughing and playing on the Meichi River.
Chen Erniu sat on the ridge of the field, looking worriedly at the crops in the field and thinking about the woman who was ill in bed.
Chen Erniu was born in Lichuankou, east of Dali Mountain. Ten years ago, Lichuankou suffered an unexplained drought. Not only was there no water falling, but white smoke was also coming out of the ground, scaring the villagers into fleeing in all directions.
He was still a half-grown child at the time, and he fled to Lijing Village in a daze. After he begged, the farmer Li Genshui took him in and rented an acre of land for him to survive the next year.
When he was older, he rented an additional acre of paddy field, built an earthen house, married Li Genshui's daughter, and took root in the village with great success.
But his wife suddenly fell ill. Fortunately, he still had some savings over the years, so he carried her to the entrance of the village for Mr. Han to see - the minor illness only required a few doses of medicine. He placed his wife with his husband, but he still couldn't let go of his worries. One illness would impoverish three generations!
"Uncle!" Chen Erniu was lost in thought, and a hearty voice woke him up.
But he saw a handsome young man walking out of the courtyard, with an eager smile on his face, greeting him.
"Hey, Changhu, I can't bear it, I can't bear it!"
Chen Erniu bent down repeatedly. He just married a concubine of the Li family and was a tenant of the family. He really couldn't claim to be the eldest son.
Li Genshui was smart and capable, but he was very carefree. He didn't have enough wives, so he went to the road to take in two women as concubines. His wife gave birth to two boys, but his concubine gave birth to three sons and four daughters.
At that time, Li Genshui was old and almost dead, but his only legitimate son who was with him died suddenly like this. Several concubines were young and strong, and they were eyeing the more than ten acres of land at home.
At this time, Li Mutian, who had run away from home, came back with a knife and his men. This brutal veteran hacked to death the housekeeper who was cheating on others, and poisoned his brother to prepare for the annexation of the wealthy family. He killed every one of them, including the dog.
Li Mutian and his two brothers carried knives dripping with blood and dragged the body on a cart. The bloody traces were dragged from the end of the village to the end of the village. Every family in the village was closed and everyone was in danger. Li Mutian's younger brothers were frightened and panicked. They thought that the real owner had come and they would lose their share of the land.
Unexpectedly, Li Mutian summoned several of his brothers and said that they were the same as the concubines. He divided the land of the big family into two acres, and gave four acres of land to each of the brothers he brought back. He was so grateful that the younger brothers repeatedly called the master's eldest brother, and this was how the title was decided.
Seeing Li Changhu's gentle smile, which somehow overlapped with Li Mutian's indifferent face splattered with blood, Chen Erniu shivered in the bright sun and asked respectfully:
"Is Changhu coming?"
"Hey, my uncle is too polite." Li Changhu smiled and said softly:
"I heard that my aunt was ill, and my father thought that my uncle would not be able to spare time to cook, so he specially asked me to invite you and Xiao Ze to the house to try my mother's cooking."
"This... I'm so embarrassed." Chen Erniu forced a smile and was in a dilemma.
"That's it! Mother has prepared the food." Li Changhu patted Chen Erniu on the shoulder, said goodbye and left.
"Okay." Chen Erniu smiled, shook his head, and shouted into the room:
"Ozawa, pack up and go to your uncle's house for dinner tonight."
The Li family renovated the house the year before last, and the land area was expanded several times. The entire house faces north and is rectangular in shape. The front yard is built with stone bricks and has stone locks. It looks like a place for martial arts training. Chen Erniu looked at the stone locks and couldn't help but praise:
"Doesn't the Li family still have a way to practice martial arts? What a stone lock."
Stepping on the stone bricks, we entered the main courtyard. There was a pond built in the center and a few herrings were placed in it. On the left and right of the lobby surrounded by bluestones were the pairs of Li Changhu and Li Tongya.There are stone steps or stone steps at the bottom of the house, verandah, gate and second door, which looks very grand.
Li Tongya greeted and entered the main courtyard. Now he is eighteen years old, but he has not yet married. Li Changhu actually married the second daughter of the Ren family, and he had married into the family with great success some time ago.
Chen Erniu had dinner with everyone in the Li family and sat in the courtyard chatting, but he saw Li Chijing hurried into the front yard and whispered a few words in Li Mutian's ear.
Li Chijing was only nine years old, but he was handsome and smart, which made him particularly popular among his uncles, nephews and brothers.
Li Mutian was leisurely watching his children chatting, when he heard Li Chijing whisper in his ear:
"Father, then... the jianzi shines!"
He remained calm, patted his legs, and said to everyone:
"I'm old, but I can't sit still. I'll go and have a rest while you guys chat." After saying that, he turned around and went to the backyard. Everyone hurriedly responded. Chen Erniu bowed and was about to leave.
There were several side rooms in the back hall, and Li Mutian entered the ancestral hall, which was located in the center and was the most spacious. In front of the ancestral hall was a memorial tablet with melons and fruits, offering sacrifices to the six generations of ancestors who had been found in the village annals.
Li Mutian pushed on the wall, revealing the compartment at the back.
The skylight was open in the compartment, and the moonlight fell on a stone platform made of bluestone inside.
There was a blue-grey bronze mirror placed on the stone platform, and it was indeed shining with white light like water.
"Three years... Jing'er, go and call your brothers."
Li Mutian looked at the gray bronze mirror and frowned.
"Yes." Li Chijing nodded vigorously and went out to find his brothers.
————
When Lu Jiangxian woke up, his mind was filled with information. He paused for a stick of incense and began to read the information on the jade stone.
"Taiyin Breathing and Nourishing Wheel Sutra"!
This method mainly teaches how to control the aura of heaven and earth through the "orifices" of the human body, activate the lunar moonlight, and finally cultivate the six wheels of fetal breath. You can use these six wheels to extend your life, nourish your nature, and perform various spells. After the six rounds have been raised to resemble a full moon, you can enter the Qi training period.
Later, there are also several minor techniques, such as golden light technique, clothing purification technique, water avoidance technique, exorcism technique, heart connection technique, etc. All you need to do is cultivate six rounds and activate the spiritual energy according to the method.
At the same time, Fa Jue talks about the six realms of cultivating immortality, which are divided into fetal breath, Qi training, foundation building, Zifu, golden elixir, and Yuanying. What this jade stone records is the fetal breath nourishing wheel method of the Yuehua Yuan Palace, the Yue Kingdom Immortal Palace, and was given to Yue Hua Immortal Palace fetal breath disciples to learn and practice.
After swallowing the jade, Lu Jiangxian felt that he had understood a lot of things invisibly. Not only had the range of his spiritual consciousness expanded to twenty feet, but the upper limit of the power of the moonlight had also increased dozens of times. As long as the power of the moonlight was enough, several minor techniques recorded in the "Taiyin Breathing and Breathing Wheel Sutra" could also be performed within one foot of the mirror body.
The most important thing is that a spell emerged from the memory of the mirror itself, called:
"Xuanzhu Sacrificial Spiritual Technique"!
(End of chapter)
